timeline.title: Amit Shah flags off India's first LNG train, launches Rs 1,542 crore railway projects
timeline.description: Amit Shah inaugurated India's first LNG-powered train and several railway projects valued at over Rs 1,542 crore. The LNG-powered train utilizes a dual-fuel system, helping to significantly reduce diesel consumption. Shah also laid the foundation for the indigenous Kavach automatic train protection system, targeting enhanced railway safety. Additionally, the Sabarmati-Sarkhej railway line doubling project aims to improve connectivity and facilitate industrial growth.
